notifications.danger: The soother chain on the product can easily break, releasing small parts. The button eyes on the doll’s shirt can also easily detach. notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: ImporterCategory of measure(s): Import rejected at borderDate of entry into force: 26/06/2025
notifications.description: Battery-operated plush toy, in the shape of a walking and barking brown dog.

notifications.name: POWER CHARGER
notifications.danger: The insulation of the product is inadequate. The user could receive an electric shock from accessible live parts. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 60335-1.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: DistributorCategory of measure(s): Withdrawal of the product from the marketDate of entry into force: 19/06/2024
notifications.description: USB charger with black plastic cover, integrated mains plug and one USB-A socket.

notifications.name: PORTABLE AND COMPACT POWER ADAPTER
notifications.danger: The insulation of the product is inadequate. The user could receive an electric shock from accessible live parts. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standard EN 60335-1.

notifications.name: Digital Scale Professional-Mini
notifications.danger: The solders in the product have an excessive concentration of lead (measured value up to 68% by weight).Lead poses a risk to the environment. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Directive on the restriction of the use of certain hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment (RoHS 2 Directive).
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: ImporterCategory of measure(s): Import rejected at borderDate of entry into force: 18/07/2025
notifications.description: Black digital scale with LCD display and touch buttons, about 30 cm wide.

notifications.name: EXTREME Power
notifications.danger: According to the list of ingredients, the product contains 2-(4-tert-butylbenzyl) propionaldehyde (BMHCA), which is prohibited in cosmetic products. BMHCA may harm the reproductive system, may harm the health of the unborn child and may cause skin sensitisation. The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: RetailerCategory of measure(s): Destruction of the productDate of entry into force: 05/08/2025
notifications.description: Aftershave, 100 ml.

notifications.name: Fashion Girl
notifications.danger: The plastic material of the doll contains an excessive amount of bis(2- ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) and dibutyl phthalate (DBP) (measured values up to 30.38% and 0.5% by weight, respectively). These phthalates may harm the health of children by causing possible damage to their reproductive system. The product does not comply with the REACH Regulation.
notifications.measures: Type of economic operator to whom the measure(s) were ordered: RetailerCategory of measure(s): Destruction of the productDate of entry into force: 11/08/2025
notifications.description: Plastic doll, with long braided hair and a colourful sleeveless dress. Size: 28 cm.
